INITIAL NOTIFICATION OF TRANSACTIONS OF PERSONS DISCHARGING MANAGERIAL RESPONSIBILITY (PDMRs) IN ACCORDANCE WITH ARTICLE 19 OF THE UK MARKET ABUSE REGULATION

NatWest Group plc (the Company) was notified on 28 August 2026 that the trustee of the Company's Buy As You Earn Share Plan (the Plan) purchased ordinary shares of £1.0769* each in the Company (Shares) (ISIN:GB00BM8PJY71) on 28 August 2026 on behalf of the PDMR named below as a participant in the Plan.

The trustee of the Plan also purchased Shares on behalf of the PDMR on 28 April 2026 (25 Shares at £5.8361 per Share), 28 May 2026 (25 Shares at £5.9460 per Share), 29 June 2026 (23 Shares at £6.5460 per Share) and 28 July 2026 (23 Shares at £6.6949 per Share).
The transactions took place on the London Stock Exchange (XLON).
* Note: the nominal value of ordinary shares without rounding is £1.076923076923077 per share
